english_text: Kage massacred everyone in my hometown...

english_text: Don't mess with a Ryukyu warrior!
I hear the weeping of departed souls...

I can't just leave them like that...
Someone must stop it...
korean_translation:
이대로 내버려 둘 순 없어…
누군가 막아야 해…

english_text:
Since ancient times, Bushido has had
an absolute code of "loyalty".

But if your master deviates from that code,
 what should you do?
korean_translation: 허나 주군이 도를 벗어났을 때는 어찌해야 하는가?

english_text: Is giving up "loyalty", also one way of Bushido?
Ready!

I can't believe Meikyokan is
really a secret group of assassins!

And now that I know their secret,
they'll come after me.
korean_translation: 게다가 비밀을 알아 버렸으니, 이젠 날 쫓아오겠지.

english_text: What am I going to do!?
I know what Utsusemi will do.
korean_translation: 우츠세미 님이 무엇을 하실지는 알고 있어요.

english_text:
However, if he fights Utsusemi,
at best they'll kill each other.
korean_translation: 하지만 두 분이 싸우면, 잘해 봐야 둘 다 죽고 말 거예요.

english_text: I can't let that happen.
So it was for this venomous cursed blade, Yugiri...
korean_translation: 그래, 모든 것은 이 독기 서린 요도 ‘유기리’ 때문이었군…

english_text:
If I do nothing,
it's as if I'm waiting for him to kill me.
korean_translation: 가만히 있어 봐야 놈이 날 죽이러 오기만 기다리는 꼴이지.

english_text: Should I go after him...or not?
korean_translation: 내가 먼저 놈을 쫓아가야 하나… 어쩌나…?

english_text: Yugiri, the cursed sword...
So this is what freaked him out...huh?
korean_translation: 이게 그 영감을 미치게 한 물건이로군…?

english_text:
Still alive? Hey!? Why did you order
Black Lotus to massacre my people? Why!?
korean_translation: 아직 살아 있나? 어이! 왜 블랙 로터스에게 내 일족을 몰살하라고 명령했지? 왜냐고!?

english_text: `I'll never tell...you..."
Hey! Dojo Master!

Why!? Godammit!
Why did this have to happen!?
korean_translation:
왜냐고! 젠장!
대체 왜 이렇게 된 거야!?

english_text: `Your sword's soul is not empty......"
korean_translation: 네 검의 혼은 비어 있지 않다…

english_text:
That's what Utsusemi said...
I feel drained.
korean_translation: 우츠세미 영감이 했던 말이지… 기운이 쭉 빠지는군.

english_text:
The sky...so blue.
Just like back in Ryukyu...

The only thing missing are
Ryukyu purple butterflies.
korean_translation: 류큐의 보랏빛 나비가 없는 것만 빼면 말이지.

english_text: `Eyaaah..."
You OK?
`Yes, I...who are you?"

Don't worry about me.
`But..."
We live in two totally different worlds.
`Wait, I...."
Sayonara, baby...

Yugiri, the cursed sword...
but it's not the sword's fault.
korean_translation: 요도 유기리… 하지만 검에게 죄는 없어.

english_text: `So...you knew...all along...?"
Master Kannagisai, I was careless.
I had no idea there was someone else behind him...
korean_translation: 그자의 뒤에 또 다른 자가 있었을 줄은 몰랐습니다…

english_text:
But unless we do something about it,
Tatara shrine will be destroyed.
korean_translation: 하지만 손을 쓰지 않으면 타타라 신사가 파괴되고 말 겁니다.

english_text:
I'll rebuild Kage, and take revenge

korean_translation: 반드시 카게를 재건하고, 우리의 원수에게 복수하겠습니다!

He was here just now...
I'm sure I saw him!
korean_translation: 분명 방금까지 여기 있었어… 틀림없이 봤는데!

english_text: `Mikado, are you leaving?"

Don't worry...
It's not as if I'm going off to die...
korean_translation: 걱정 마… 죽으러 가는 건 아니니까…

It's over...

I, Black Lotus, have lived the Samurai code
for 10 years.
korean_translation: 이 블랙 로터스, 십 년 동안 무사의 도리를 지키며 살아왔소.

english_text:
I never expected things to end this way.
But, this is my fate.
korean_translation: 이런 결말을 맞을 줄은 몰랐지만… 이것 또한 나의 운명이오.

english_text:
I lived for Bushido...and now...
I'll die for it!

english_text: What a waste...killing yourself like that.
korean_translation: 그렇게 스스로 목숨을 끊다니… 어리석은 사람.

korean_translation: 그런 당신을 이렇게 오래 기다린 나도 바보였어.

I won...
I even beat the Dojo Master...

I'm so much stronger now, it feels like years
have passed since my first kill.

english_text: Swordsmanship isn't brute force...
It's timing.

I think I'm finally beginning to understand
what I've been taught so many times.
korean_translation: 수없이 배웠던 가르침을 이제야 조금 알 것 같아.

english_text: I'm strong...and getting stronger...
korean_translation: 난 강해… 지금도 더 강해지고 있어…

english_text:
Sorry...
At first, I was only trying to stay alive.
korean_translation: 미안해… 처음엔 그저 살아남으려 했을 뿐이었어.

english_text:
But now, because of you,
I know how addictive murder is.
korean_translation: 하지만 네 덕분에 사람을 베는 쾌락을 알아 버렸어.

`Get out!"

`I don't have time for any of
your childish jokes, boy!"

it's about getting stronger...that's all.
Don't take it personal.

`Certainly even a killing machine

english_text: `I under...estimated...you."

korean_translation: 이제 카게는 사라졌으니, 나 같은 사람은 필요 없어.

I'm alone again.

I'm sorry...

why were you after me?

english_text: Looks like you got a little too old, Pops.
korean_translation: 영감, 아무래도 나이를 너무 먹은 모양이군.

english_text: Is the Dojo Master controlling everyone?
Why did you try to kill me?
I never thought I would ever have to kill you.
I must see how far I can make it...

Still so young...
don't throw your life away for nothing.
korean_translation: 아직 젊은데 목숨을 헛되이 버리지 마라.
